title: Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2611.29732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations. However, collecting demonstrations is expensive, and the demonstrations themselves can be suboptimal. In this work, we use a large language model (LLM) to generate an advice policy that produces demonstration data with effectively no human cost. We use this data to warmstart a DQN agent, and use the advice policy itself to guide exploration during training. Because LLM-generated advice is often suboptimal, we further introduce a value warmstart method that initializes the agent to recognize promising states from the advice policy's behavior, without directly copying its actions. To characterize the robustness of this method, we systematically perturb individual sub-skills of an LLM-gen

translated_title: 基于大语言模型生成的（次优）示范的强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）在许多领域取得了重大进展，但从零开始训练智能体仍然非常缺乏样本效率。一种常见的补救方法是使用在示范数据上预训练的神经网络来初始化智能体。然而，收集示范数据成本高昂，且示范本身可能是次优的。在这项工作中，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）生成一个建议策略，以几乎零人工成本产生示范数据。我们使用这些数据对DQN智能体进行热启动，并利用建议策略本身在训练过程中引导探索。由于LLM生成的建议往往是次优的，我们进一步引入了一种价值热启动方法，该方法将智能体初始化为能够从建议策略的行为中识别有前景的状态，而不直接复制其动作。为了表征该方法的鲁棒性，我们系统地扰动LLM生成的建议策略的各个子技能，以研究……
tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型以近零人工成本生成次优示范数据来热启动DQN智能体，并通过价值热启动方法让智能体学会识别有前景的状态而非直接复制动作，同时用建议策略引导探索，从而提升强化学习的样本效率与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using an LLM to generate suboptimal demonstrations at nearly zero human cost to warmstart a DQN agent, introducing a value warmstart method that learns to recognize promising states instead of directly copying actions, while leveraging the advice policy to guide exploration, thereby improving RL sample efficiency and robustness.
